name: ZFSet.sep_empty_iff
statement:
theorem sep_empty_iff {A : ZFSet} {P : ZFSet → Prop} : A.sep P = ∅ ↔ (A = ∅ ∨ ∀ x ∈ A, ¬ P x) where
  mp h
proof:
:= by classical
    by_cases A_emp : A = ∅
    · left; assumption
    · right
      intros x mem_x_A
      by_contra contr
      have : x ∈ A.sep P := by
        rw [mem_sep]
        exact ⟨mem_x_A, contr⟩
      rw [h] at this
      nomatch this, notMem_empty _
  mpr h := by classical
    rcases h with rfl | h
    · exact sep_empty P
    · ext1 z
      constructor
      · intro hz
        rw [mem_sep] at hz
        nomatch h _ hz.left, hz.right
      · intro hz
        nomatch notMem_empty z, hz

name: ZFSet.prod_inj
statement:
theorem prod_inj {A B C D : ZFSet} (h : A.prod B = C.prod D) (hA : A ≠ ∅) (hB : B ≠ ∅) :
    A = C ∧ B = D
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := nonempty_exists_iff.mp hA
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := nonempty_exists_iff.mp hB
  obtain ⟨aC, bD⟩ : a ∈ C ∧ b ∈ D := by
    rw [←pair_mem_prod, ←h, pair_mem_prod]
    exact ⟨ha, hb⟩
  rw [ZFSet.ext_iff, ZFSet.ext_iff]
  suffices ∀ x y, (x ∈ A ↔ x ∈ C) ∧ (y ∈ B ↔ y ∈ D) by
    and_intros
    · intro z
      specialize this z b
      exact this.1
    · intro z
      specialize this a z
      exact this.2
  rw [ZFSet.ext_iff] at h
  simp only [mem_prod] at h
  intro x y
  and_intros
  · specialize h (x.pair b)
    simp only [pair_inj, exists_eq_right_right'] at h
    constructor <;> intro hx
    · exact (h.mp ⟨hx, hb⟩).1
    · exact (h.mpr ⟨hx, bD⟩).1
  · specialize h (a.pair y)
    simp only [pair_inj, exists_eq_right_right'] at h
    constructor <;> intro hy
    · exact (h.mp ⟨ha, hy⟩).2
    · exact (h.mpr ⟨aC, hy⟩).2

--   ⋃₀ (A.powerset.sep λ 𝒟 => IsFunc 𝒟 B f) --NOTE: this def was specific to functions

abbrev Dom (f : ZFSet) {A B : ZFSet}
    (hf : f ⊆ A.prod B := by
      first
      | sorry_if_sorry
      | ( have := ZFSet.mem_funs.mp ‹_ ∈ ZFSet.funs _ _›
          with_reducible solve_by_elim using zrel, zpfun, zfun)
      | with_reducible solve_by_elim using zrel, zpfun, zfun) :=
  A.sep (fun x => ∃ y ∈ B, x.pair y ∈ f)


abbrev Range (f : ZFSet) {A B : ZFSet}
    (hf : f ⊆ A.prod B := by
      first
      | sorry_if_sorry
      | ( have := ZFSet.mem_funs.mp ‹_ ∈ ZFSet.funs _ _›
          with_reducible solve_by_elim using zrel, zpfun, zfun)
      | with_reducible solve_by_elim using zrel, zpfun, zfun) :=
  B.sep (fun y => ∃ x ∈ A, x.pair y ∈ f)


/-- The range of a relation does not depend on the ambient sets used to form it. -/
